name: Spoon
description: The household shopping list and recipe book.
_comment_display: standalone. Fullscreen was tried in v9.2 to escape the system bars entirely and was worse: Android left a black band where the status bar had been, cutout and all, and hid the gesture bar. Reverted in v9.3.
_comment_colours: theme_color and the two color_scheme_dark spellings are all deliberately ABSENT. Chrome 93+ fills BOTH the light and the dark status-bar colour from the page's <meta name=theme-color media=(prefers-color-scheme: ...)> tags, but only for an installed PWA - that is what the Dark theme color row at chrome://webapks shows. A manifest theme_color overrides those metas (proven in v9.1-v9.4: the manifest colour won in every theme), and neither color_scheme_dark spelling was accepted (v9.7: both dark rows stayed empty). So the manifest stays out of the way and index.html owns both colours. background_color only tints the launch splash.
